# Sound

Sound marks the few moments worth hearing, and lands with the motion that shows them.

**Kind:** Foundation

**Storybook page:** `design-system/src/styles/SoundOverview.mdx`

## Overview

A sound plays where a moment matters and a tutor may be looking elsewhere: a Flag arriving, a step done, a sign-up confirmed. Every sound is synthesized in the browser from one material, a dry abacus bead, so there are no audio files.

## Principles

### Rare

Most moments are silent. A sound plays only where its registry row names one: When to play.

### Paired

Every sound has an on-screen change that says the same thing, so turning sound off loses nothing: Settings and accessibility.

### Landed

A sound lands when its motion lands: With motion.

### In key

Every sound is in one key, so any two can play back to back: Sounds.

## The nine sounds

Press one to hear it. The switch is the same setting the app reads; Sounds adds the three AI feedback sounds.
